answer: Agents must lock a stake at the inlet before their vouchers count. A trellis of mutual attestations grants weight only to nodes whose stake is real and whose vouchers loop back to a known-good anchor, so a lone clone has no path to trust. To win, a Sybil farmer must fund every fake identity separately: a hundred faces need a hundred stakes, and the moment one is caught vouching twice, slashing burns the whole pile. Climbing above the ledge where payouts start therefore costs more than any single reward, so splitting into many wallets is a losing trade.
